ResearchProjectDef.label: apex evolution I
ResearchProjectDef.description: A compression protocol that encodes archotech evolutionary data into a dense crystalline medium — the Apex Crystal (Basic). Absorption by a Synthera avatar triggers an immediate, permanent rewrite of its base parameters: increased movement speed, work output, and resilience across all systems. The change is irreversible. The avatar that absorbs the crystal is not upgraded — it is replaced by a more capable version of itself.

ResearchProjectDef.label: apex evolution II
ResearchProjectDef.description: The compression density reaches a second tier — archotech data encoded at twice the concentration of the first crystal. Absorption triggers a second evolutionary rewrite, dramatically amplifying all parameters beyond the original design envelope. A Synthera that has absorbed both Tier I and Tier II crystals operates at a level that approaches, but does not yet reach, the theoretical limit of what its substrate can contain.

ResearchProjectDef.label: apex evolution III — transcendent
ResearchProjectDef.description: The totality of recoverable archotech evolutionary potential compressed into a single uniform crystal — the Apex Crystal (Pure). Absorption rewrites every parameter simultaneously: movement, combat, work output, resilience, and system efficiency all shift beyond what any prior tier could achieve. A Synthera that absorbs all three tiers has reached the theoretical ceiling of its substrate. What remains is no longer synthetic in the conventional sense. The designation still applies — but it no longer fully describes what it contains.

ResearchProjectDef.label: altar enhancement I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Supplementary hardware modules that attach directly to existing altar infrastructure. Unlocks slot expanders (increase avatar capacity), respawn boosters (accelerate hibernation recovery), and cooling arrays (reduce heat output on Tier I altars). Each module is a targeted improvement — stack them to tune your altars for your colony's specific needs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: altar enhancement II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Advanced altar infrastructure that pushes existing structures beyond their baseline specifications. Power condensers reduce energy draw by a further 20%, while high-tier slot expanders allow altars to simultaneously host more avatars than their base design intended. These modules represent significant material investment — but the throughput gains compound with every altar in your colony.

ResearchProjectDef.label: holographic resonance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Resonance imaging refined to the point where a digital consciousness can be broadcast as coherent light rather than anchored to a physical substrate. The Holographic Stage reconstructs a complete Synthera avatar from pure projection — no physical body, no heat generation, a fraction of the power footprint. Designed specifically for the virtual diva substrate, it trades labor capacity for something harder to quantify: presence.
